name: voteright-admin-docx-generator
description: Regenerates Operations Calendar.docx and Ops Tracking.docx from their markdown sources (docs/OPERATIONS-CALENDAR.md in this repo, and a Claude Code memory file local to the owner's machine) whenever either changes. Run: npm install (once, or whenever node_modules is missing) then node generate-docx.js from this directory. Output is NOT written here -- it lands in the owner's local, gitignored Adminstration/ folder (hardcoded absolute path in generate-docx.js) since that's personal/business content this public repo must never contain.
